pre_submission_closures.evidence: Exact publication durably records root run ownership in reconciliation_exact_impacts within the canonical command transaction. Worker root selection now includes exact commands as well as human-review outcomes and validates historical Work endpoints, actor, source-version reason, fingerprints and policy before recovery. The fresh test_exact_batch_impacts_finish_after_candidate_publication_and_worker_restart creates an exact dependent, publishes a batch and its later candidate graph, shuts down and reopens the worker, then requires a materialized consumer stale state, non-running original exact runs, retained fresh-only denial and the unchanged original receipt. It passes in the authenticated 146-case reconciliation log. This closure concerns resumed owned exact runs; it does not claim the separately overstated foreign exact-root negative test was executed.

Changed graph recovery authenticates exact/review ownership, all saved run seals, item manifests and checkpoint chains, then creates a fresh same-semantics preview/run, seals and links the child, and cancels the predecessor in one writer transaction. The engine's unchanged-graph snapshot and authority checks remain intact; manual terminal states are not revived. Fresh tests test_review_impacts_recover_from_unrelated_graph_growth_without_releasing_stale_outputs, test_partial_impact_continuation_rolls_back_at_every_seam_and_recovers_after_lost_ack, test_repeated_graph_growth_follows_saved_chain_without_forking_or_reviving_terminal_roots, test_real_graph_growth_does_not_turn_corrupted_saved_authority_into_a_continuation and the exact-batch restart case pass. They require stale materialization, completed continuation, preserved denial/history, atomic rollback at all three continuation seams, 100-of-102 partial recovery, lost acknowledgement, repeated growth and saved graph/preview/authority/item/checkpoint corruption denial. The explicit 128-link bound remains a fail-closed resource limit, not a promise of completion during indefinite graph change.

After authenticating saved state, recovery gathers output revision/kind, disposition, confidence and review-duty tuples from the root and every historical continuation. All must survive the current preview before any child/link/cancellation is published. Fresh tests test_removed_material_edge_cannot_discard_pending_effect_in_a_continuation and test_weakened_material_edge_cannot_discard_pending_effect_in_a_continuation each modify exactly one material edge in a synthetic database and restore the original schema trigger. They require denial, unchanged table counts and root run, and retained fresh-only denial; both pass in qualification 03. Valid repeated growth and partial/lost-ack recovery tests also pass. The original independent probe showing cancelled(1,0), completed-child(0,0) and no materialized stale cause remains unchanged. This closes effect loss; it does not claim forensic detection of every unrelated graph modification.
